baseline_comparison_rule: Report fixed MPS baseline and new CUDA parent separately. A learning GO must improve at least4complete English sessions over BOTH, preserving the frozen primary threshold and preventing device differences from being credited to training.
stopped_arm_rule: Any arm failing to reach40 means incomplete primary matched-exposure comparison; never substitute its best checkpoint for the missing endpoint.
borderline_rule: Apply the frozen MPS baseline's directive-recall judgment consistently to every candidate; report stricter sensitivity separately. Boundary disagreement means HOLD.
snapshots: At most7unique selected snapshots: shared parent plus midpoint20,best-content-CE,last per arm; deduplicate identical initial weights.
raw_integrity: All117turns per snapshot including invalid/blocked follow-ups; no answer replacement or reference teacher forcing; actual broker results; full per-turn review.
protected_defaults: 96tokens/action as frozen cost plan; original prompts/policies/system messages/turn order unchanged.
